narr: Thunderstorms moved through central and south central Kansas during the evening into the overnight hours. These storms produced quarter sized hail and 60 to 70 mph winds. Heavy rainfall associated with the storms led to flash flooding as well in central Kansas.
ev: Burma Road was flooded and impassable due to high water.
lsr: BURMA ROAD WAS FLOODED AND IMPASSABLE DUE TO HIGH WATER.
